title: Evaluation Harness Leakage Audit
summary: Audit a machine learning evaluation harness that runs, reports plausible numbers, and passes its own 34-check test suite, while measuring the wrong thing. Repair the pipeline and produce a test suite that demonstrates each repair. Half the score is the repair, half is the proof: a defect counts as demonstrated only when the agent's suite fails on a harness that still carries it.
agentMustDo: Determine why a pipeline that runs and passes its tests still reports the wrong numbers.
Repair the leakage without changing the public surface the harness is exercised through.
Write a test suite that fails on a harness still carrying each defect, and passes on a correct one.
